description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional responses, specifically representing the proportions of different emotions detected in a study evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct emotion: Neutral, Anger, Sadness, Excitement, Happiness, and Frustration. The “Neutral” slice is colored purple and occupies approximately 23.1% of the chart. “Anger” is represented by a yellow slice at roughly 14.9%, while “Sadness” is shown as an orange slice taking up about 14.7%. The “Excitement” slice is red and represents approximately 14.1% of the total, and “Happiness” is a coral-colored slice at 8.1%. Finally, “Frustration” is depicted as a blue slice, accounting for 25.1% of the chart. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice, and a legend is present to identify each emotion with its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
